sources.title: GLM-4.5-Flash official model guide
sources.evidence: Dedicated exact-model page lists text input/output, 128K context, 96K output, thinking enabled/disabled and Function Calling. Its retirement notice says BigModel would retire this model on January 30, 2026 and route requests to GLM-4.7-Flash. Accessed complete Markdown version; no model size or topology is disclosed.

sources.title: July 28, 2025 archived original GLM-4.5-Flash launch guide
sources.publisher: Zhipu / BigModel, preserved by Internet Archive
sources.evidence: Retrieved archived HTML directly. July 28 12:39:29 UTC snapshot explicitly calls glm-4.5-flash newly launched and free to use, with 128K context, 96K output, text input/output, optional thinking and Function Call. Benchmark material separately names GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.5-Air; it does not say Flash equals either model.

sources.title: BigModel model and product release log
sources.evidence: July 28, 2025 entry announces the GLM-4.5 series. Used with the same-day exact Flash launch guide, not alone to transfer the family date to Flash.

sources.title: GLM-4.5 official API family guide
sources.evidence: Lists GLM-4.5-Flash as a separate free option. Its numerical model introduction explicitly names GLM-4.5 at 355B/32B and GLM-4.5-Air at 106B/12B. It does not explicitly map Flash to either checkpoint or disclose a Flash-specific architecture.

sources.title: GLM-4.5: Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding (ARC) Foundation Models
sources.evidence: Later first-party technical report describes standard GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.5-Air and their MoE architecture. Full HTML has no occurrence of Flash. Report parameter accounting includes MTP and excludes embeddings/output layers; none of those counts or architectural facts establishes an exact Flash specification.

sources.title: Official Z.ai public model repository inventory
sources.evidence: Read 154 public repository entries. GLM-4.5, Air, Base, Air-Base, FP8, Air-FP8 and vision variants appear, but no GLM-4.5-Flash checkpoint. This supports keeping the hosted-only classification; absence alone does not prove Flash is a service tier of another model.

sources.title: Official GLM-4.5 model card
sources.evidence: Card names and links the released standard/Air checkpoints and their MIT licensing. It provides no exact Flash checkpoint or explicit same-model mapping. MIT is therefore not transferred to the hosted Flash entry.

sources.title: Later GLM-4.7-Flash official model card
sources.evidence: Exact successor is a 30B-A3B MoE model. Its comparison table does not report original GLM-4.5-Flash counts. Successor specifications cannot describe the original model merely because BigModel later reroutes its API identifier.

sources.title: Z.ai Terms of Use and API service terms
sources.evidence: Section V reserves model parameters, algorithms, code and architecture IP to Z.ai. Additional API terms grant limited service access without transferring ownership. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification for this hosted model, not a named checkpoint license.

sources.title: Original Dify Z.ai integration for exact glm-4.5-flash identifier
sources.evidence: Pinned integration implementation assigns glm-4.5-flash context_size 131072 and max_tokens 98304, matching the native guide’s 128K/96K convention. This is original integration evidence for explicit integer limits, not evidence of undisclosed model internals.

name.note: Exact dedicated model title and historical API identifier.

developer.note: Z.ai is the international developer brand; the native BigModel documentation is published by Zhipu.

family.note: Retain the existing normalized GLM Flash family key for the explicitly named Flash variant; this grouping does not imply a shared checkpoint or parameter count with other Flash models.

release_date.note: Exact Flash guide was archived July 28, 2025 and explicitly says newly launched and free to use. Same-day native series release log corroborates launch timing. This is dated public availability evidence, not a repository creation date or a later international provider listing.

open_weights.note: The exact original Flash is documented as a hosted API model. No corresponding public checkpoint or explicit identity with standard/Air open checkpoints was found in the checked official inventory and model cards. Free API use does not establish open weights.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-service classification supported by API terms. No Flash-specific weight license was found; standard/Air MIT grants cannot be inherited without an exact model mapping.

parameters_b.note: No exact Flash total disclosed in the original/current guides, later GLM-4.5 technical report, or checked original/successor cards. Neither standard 355B, Air 106B, nor successor Flash 30B can be transferred.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact original Flash active count disclosed. Standard 32B, Air 12B and GLM-4.7-Flash 3B belong to explicitly different named models.

architecture.note: Optional thinking is inference behavior, not a topology disclosure. Primary research searches and later report/card checks did not identify Flash-specific Transformer or MoE architecture. The MoE descriptions name standard/Air or the later 4.7-Flash.

context_window.note: Original native Flash documentation reports 128K context and 96K output. Pinned original integration explicitly resolves those as 131072 and 98304. Retain the original model limit; do not substitute the successor endpoint limit after rerouting.

modalities.note: Native exact-model tables explicitly list text input and text output. Tool browsing does not add visual input modality.

reasoning.note: Exact-model guide documents hybrid reasoning and thinking.type enabled/disabled.

tool_call.note: Exact-model guide explicitly lists Function Calling and tool-use integration.

description.value: Hosted GLM text model with optional reasoning and function calling.
description.note: Replaces vague speed/efficiency wording with documented interface behavior, without implying undisclosed architecture or an open checkpoint.

patch.description: Hosted GLM text model with optional reasoning and function calling.
patch.notes: Original GLM-4.5-Flash was publicly documented as newly launched on July 28, 2025. Its total parameters, active parameters and architecture are undisclosed in the checked primary sources; no explicit identity with GLM-4.5 or GLM-4.5-Air was established. Free API access does not establish open weights. BigModel announced retirement on January 30, 2026 and automatic routing to GLM-4.7-Flash; the original model specifications are retained, and the successor’s 30B/3B MoE figures are not transferred. This retirement notice is specific to BigModel and does not prove current operation or universal retirement across providers.

summary: Verified July 28, 2025 using the archived exact original Flash launch guide. Retained hosted-only weights status, 131072 original context, text modalities, reasoning and tools. Added supported proprietary classification and factual description. Counts/topology remain null after exact-model and later-primary checks. No service-tier exclusion proposed: free pricing alone does not establish identity with standard GLM-4.5 or Air. Documented BigModel retirement/rerouting to avoid importing successor specifications.
